scope: Independent algebra/source-contract review of the planned fixed C=[-24,0], R60 guide and M6 delta +/-2 mm. No CAD changes, no physical fit or preload acceptance.

thread_budget.full_thread_claim_condition: Actual end chamfer / incomplete thread and head-side runout must each fit within the corresponding remaining margin (minimum 1.2 mm); source cylinders do not certify this. Nominal 3.2 mm nut overlap is not bolt strength or tightening approval.
thread_budget.range_enforcement: No physical +/-2 mm stop is proved here. A measurable assembly setting and min/max witness marks are required if the final design uses the bounded budget.

kinematics.formula: phi=atan2(60*sin(theta)+24,60*cos(theta))-acos(60/rho); rho^2=24^2+60^2+2*24*60*sin(theta); L(theta,delta)=5-delta+60*phi+sqrt(rho^2-3600); L(0,delta)=29-delta. Angles in radians in this formula.
kinematics.incremental_formula: u(theta)=60*phi+sqrt(rho^2-3600)-24, independent of delta under the listed conditions.
kinematics.derivative: du/dtheta=60*cos(theta-phi)>0 on theta 0..30 deg; the forward tangent branch is used.
conditions: Guide centre, radius and tangent start S=[-24,60,2] remain fixed; only Q shifts along the same local X line, with positive gap 5-delta (3..7 mm).

The core remains taut and follows the intended convex guide contact and forward tangent branch; axial confinement, real groove contact/friction, flexible-core stretch and preload are separate physical requirements.

Delta is held fixed during a trigger stroke. The rest position is re-established after changing delta. Adjustment changes absolute cable-length/slack/preload balance even though the same-delta increment cancels algebraically.

Ferrule seating and the core passage move with the adjuster, stay coaxial, and contribute theta-independent length; their supplier-undimensioned tapers cannot be used as exact fixed reaction coordinates.

route_review.existing_input_source: cr_input_port() reads old ci_spec().adjuster_overall_x[0], still -63; no delta parameter.
route_review.minimal_geometric_endpoint_variant: Keep first arc and all downstream curves fixed; move only P to P+delta*basis_x. Its initial collinear segment is 25+delta mm (23..27). This describes endpoint geometry only.
route_review.constant_cut_length_problem: That variant changes the outside route length by delta. One already cut, non-stretched housing cannot keep every downstream curve unchanged at all delta values. Free upstream bends need an explicit compensating route family or must be re-laid and checked during installation before the adjustment is locked.
required_bounded_update: Use the same delta in adjuster, ferrule, actual housing end, entrance port, internal core straight and render/contract; do not leave cr_housing at the old endpoint.

Include the continuous +/-2 mm sweep of the metal/ferrule/port against body, rotating parts, neighbours and actual tool corridors. For any chosen flexible route family, check its full envelope, length compatibility and R>=65; endpoint-only translation is not a bound on arbitrary hose deformation.

Recheck the 16 csr service envelopes against the chosen full housing-route envelope. csr_route_envelope currently uses full nominal cr_points plus 1 mm clearance and explicitly excludes end fittings, so ferrule/adjuster sweeps require separate checks.

Retain cover-off, module-on-bench nut adjustment; verify the fixed 3 mm SW10 wrench envelopes against the shifted fittings. A tool/hold method for the SW8 adjuster head and any loosened-nut state is not certified by the existing fixed-nut tool model.

Define delta=0 datum, +/-2 max settings or witness marks, and assembly sequence: seat and route housing, set zero/slack, tighten both nuts, then set the feeder hard-stop range. Recheck zero after any later adjuster movement.
not_proved: Exact ferrule seating depth due to undimensioned supplier taper/chamfer
Constant physical housing cut length across the full adjustment range with downstream route fixed
Complete in-place SW8 turning access or loosened nut state
Bare core bending lifetime, friction, preload, real print clearance and structural strength
route_review.followup_owned_by_root: Root is constructing an equal-length family by moving only the first virtual corner along the input axis while fixing the second/third/output vertices. That family is not inspected or accepted by this report yet.
